field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this instance. Disabled instances are skipped on start and reconfigure.

field.label: Name
field.help: Display name for this instance in the table

field.label: Manual Subscription
field.help: Source for Manual mode. LeastLoad can use nodes from any enabled subscription.

field.label: Traffic Selection
field.help: Manual uses one selected node. LeastLoad distributes new connections among observed healthy nodes in the pool.

field.label: Manual Active Node
field.help: Used only in Manual mode. The first node is used when no node is selected.

field.label: LeastLoad Pool
field.help: Choose at least two nodes from any enabled subscription. Each item shows its source and node name.

field.label: Fallback Node
field.help: Required in LeastLoad mode; may come from any enabled subscription.

field.label: Selected Nodes (expected)
field.help: Number of best healthy pool nodes eligible for load distribution. Default: 2.

field.label: Failure Tolerance
field.help: Maximum acceptable fraction of failed probes, 0 to 1. Default: 0.2 (20%).

field.label: SOCKS5 Listen Address
field.help: IP address xray-core binds for its SOCKS5 inbound. tun2socks connects here to forward all TUN traffic through the proxy. Use 127.0.0.1 (loopback, recommended), 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces), or any IP assigned to a real OPNsense interface (e.g. 192.168.1.1). Other 127.x.x.x addresses require a manual lo0 alias on FreeBSD and are not recommended.

field.label: SOCKS5 Port
field.help: Local address/port xray-core binds for the SOCKS5 inbound. Each enabled instance must use a non-conflicting listen/port pair.
field.hint: Default: 10808. For multiple enabled instances use a unique SOCKS5 port (e.g. 10808, 10809, ...).

field.label: TUN Interface
field.help: Virtual network interface created by tun2socks. Each enabled instance must use its own interface name.
field.hint: Default: proxytun2socks0. For multiple instances use unique names (e.g. proxytun2socks0, proxytun2socks1) and match Interfaces → Assignments.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the TUN interface
field.hint: Default: 1500. Change only after PMTU/fragmentation testing; do not use a fixed reduced value by default.

field.label: Enable Sniffing
field.help: Detect HTTP, TLS and BitTorrent traffic at the SOCKS inbound for routing rules. Off by default.

field.label: Sniffing: Route Only
field.help: Use sniffed HTTP/TLS host names for routing without changing the original destination. Recommended.

field.label: Routing Domain Strategy
field.help: AsIs avoids automatic IP lookup for domain rules. IPIfNonMatch resolves a domain on a second pass if required; IPOnDemand resolves when evaluating IP rules. Default: IPIfNonMatch.

field.label: Custom Routing Rules
field.help: Ordered rules for protocol, domain, IP or port. The first match wins. Private-network direct bypass stays first; the active proxy or balancer stays last. BitTorrent detection requires Sniffing. Routing to Direct bypasses the VPN exit and may expose your public IP.

field.label: Bypass Networks
field.help: Comma-separated list of CIDR networks that should bypass the VPN tunnel and go direct. These networks will be routed via the 'direct' (freedom) outbound instead of the proxy.

field.label: Xray Log Level
field.hint: warning is recommended for production. Use debug only for troubleshooting — it generates a lot of output.
